title: Release identity is internally inconsistent
description: pyproject declares vamos-optimization 1.0.0 while runtime version, CITATION.cff, and README citation report 0.1.0.
recommendation: Align pyproject.toml, src/vamos/foundation/version.py, CITATION.cff, README citation, generated metadata, and add a version consistency architecture test.

title: Source mypy fails in archive typing and private optional-backend coupling
description: mypy reports archive errors from accessing subset_selection._moocore and using runtime Any aliases as types in archive factory/hooks.
recommendation: Introduce explicit archive protocols or type aliases and replace private _moocore mutation with a supported helper seam.

title: Formatting debt is budgeted and repo-wide Ruff fails outside the CI scope
description: Ruff lint passes for src/vamos tests, but ruff format reports 56 files and ruff check . reports 169 issues outside the gated scope.
recommendation: Format src/vamos tests, reduce the budget, and decide whether examples/paper/tools are release-gated or archival.

title: Publication-facing modules have weak or zero coverage despite a large passing suite
description: Coverage passed at 69 percent total but benchmark CLI, profiler, Panel UI, zoo CLI, and pymoo interop surfaces include 0 percent modules.
recommendation: Add focused smoke and behavior tests for benchmark CLI, profiler, pymoo adapter, and selected UI state rather than relying on global coverage.

title: python -m vamos does not work although the console script does
description: The package exposes a vamos console script, but python -m vamos --help fails because there is no vamos.__main__.
recommendation: Add src/vamos/__main__.py delegating to vamos.experiment.cli.main or document console-script-only support.

title: Default functional custom problems are elementwise not actually vectorized
description: make_problem with vectorized=False evaluates each row through a Python list comprehension, which is compatibility mode rather than vectorized execution.
recommendation: Keep scalar support but record/document vectorization mode and steer performance-sensitive users to vectorized=True or batched Problem.objectives.

title: Generic hypervolume contribution fallback is computationally expensive
description: The generic fallback computes full hypervolume then deletes one point and recomputes for every contribution.
recommendation: Require/encourage accelerated backend or approximate pruning for large many-objective archives and add microbenchmarks.

title: Reproducibility story is present but not yet a single standardized artifact path
description: README points to a publication environment but this audit did not verify a single locked reproduction command or standardized manifest schema.
recommendation: Publish and test the canonical TEVC environment plus benchmark manifest fields for commit, versions, backend availability, and seeds.

title: README citation points to maintained metadata that currently disagrees
description: README citation and CITATION.cff both show 0.1.0 while pyproject declares 1.0.0.
recommendation: Update README and CITATION.cff together and cover them with the version consistency test.

title: Pymoo interop exists but is not covered by tests in the current coverage run
description: The local PymooProblemAdapter is an external-comparison surface but coverage reports 0 percent for the module.
recommendation: Add fake-object adapter coverage and optional pymoo-installed integration coverage under the research extra.
